suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(circlize)
})
file_path <- "inputs/edge-weights-222222222222.xlsx"
# Read the long-format file
df <- read_excel(file_path)
cat("Rows:", nrow(df), "Cols:", ncol(df), "\n")
# Pivot long -> wide: rows = from (genes), columns = to (samples)
mat <- df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = to, values_from = value) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(mat) <- mat$from
mat$from <- NULL
# Sort sample columns numerically (S1, S2, ..., S10) using gsub
sample_order <- colnames(mat)[order(as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", colnames(mat))))]
mat <- mat[, sample_order]
cat("\nMatrix dims:", dim(mat), "\n")
cat("Rows (genes):", rownames(mat), "\n")
cat("Cols (samples):", colnames(mat), "\n")
print(mat)
# Save for next cell
saveRDS(mat, "chord_matrix.rds")
cat("\nMatrix saved.\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(circlize)
})
mat <- readRDS("chord_matrix.rds")
# Distinct color palettes for the two groups
n_genes   <- nrow(mat)
n_samples <- ncol(mat)
gene_colors <- setNames(
  c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488",
    "#F39B7F", "#8491B4")[seq_len(n_genes)],
  rownames(mat)
)
# ColorBrewer-style Set3 for samples (10 colors)
sample_palette <- c(
  "#8DD3C7", "#FFFFB3", "#BEBADA", "#FB8072", "#80B1D3",
  "#FDB462", "#B3DE69", "#FCCDE5", "#BC80BD", "#CCEBC5"
)
sample_colors <- setNames(sample_palette[seq_len(n_samples)], colnames(mat))
# Set gap between sectors so labels breathe
circos.par(gap.after = c(rep(3, n_genes - 1), 6,
                         rep(3, n_samples - 1), 6),
           start.degree = -90)
# Draw the chord diagram
chordDiagram(
  mat,
  grid.col      = c(gene_colors, sample_colors),
  transparency = 0.25,
  symmetric     = FALSE,
  annotationTrack = c("grid", "axis"),
  preAllocateTracks = list(
    track.height = 0.05,
    track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01)
  )
)
# Add labels on top
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector.name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
    ylim <- get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
    circos.text(
      mean(xlim), ylim[1] + 0.4, sector.name,
      facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.85
    )
  },
  bg.border = NA
)
# Add a legend mapping each sector to its color
legend_labels <- c(names(gene_colors), names(sample_colors))
legend_colors <- c(gene_colors, sample_colors)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = legend_labels,
  fill   = legend_colors,
  border = NA,
  bty    = "n",
  cex    = 0.8,
  title  = "Sector"
)
# Title
title("Chord Diagram: Genes ↔ Samples", cex.main = 1.2)
# Save as PNG
png("chord_diagram.png", width = 1800, height = 1800, res = 220)
chordDiagram(
  mat,
  grid.col      = c(gene_colors, sample_colors),
  transparency = 0.25,
  symmetric     = FALSE,
  annotationTrack = c("grid", "axis"),
  preAllocateTracks = list(
    track.height = 0.05,
    track.margin = c(0.01, 0.01)
  )
)
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector.name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
    ylim <- get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
    circos.text(
      mean(xlim), ylim[1] + 0.4, sector.name,
      facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.85
    )
  },
  bg.border = NA
)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = legend_labels,
  fill   = legend_colors,
  border = NA,
  bty    = "n",
  cex    = 0.8,
  title  = "Sector"
)
title("Chord Diagram: Genes ↔ Samples", cex.main = 1.2)
dev.off()
# Reset for next plot
circos.clear()
cat("Chord diagram rendered and saved to chord_diagram.png\n")
